C0331.title: Guangxi Baise Yu Gang Ethnic Asset Unfreezing Fraud Case
C0331.summary: In November 2022, public security authorities in Baise, Guangxi dismantled a fraud ring led by Yu Gang, arresting 60 individuals and identifying a total amount involved of 70 million yuan. Investigations revealed that Yu and his associates established an internet technology company and recruited former participants in ethnic asset unfreezing scams.
